notes.title: Trash Bomber now has a (tiny) tabletop version!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you very much for playing Trash Bomber, posting all the positive reviews, videos & screenshots and in general just being there for us! ːgrizzland_heartː

We love making 100% free games for Steam and would be happy to keep doing that from time to time in the future. Unfortunately, developing these games not only takes time, but also costs money. If you'd like see more freebies from us on this platform, please consider supporting these projects by purchasing the new "DLC" that we've just released:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2326680/Trash_Bomber_One_Mans_Trash/

It won't affect the main game in any way, because it's important for us to keep our free-to-play games totally free, without any microtransactions and other nasty monetization practices. But we can't leave our supporters empty-handed, either! Should you decide to get this "DLC", you will get a little bonus as a token of our gratitude: a printable Trash Bomber tabletop mini-game. :)

Thank you for everything once again. Have a wonderful day!

Sincerely Yours,
Ivan (Khud0)
